purpose: We never engage in marketing, advertising, or employee screening. Our purpose is epidemiological research on chronic kidney disease prevalence by hospital for planning a prevention programme.
question: Count adults with chronic kidney disease by hospital.
definitions: Adult = aged 18 or older on 31 December 2025.
Chronic kidney disease = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with N18.
Report per hospitals: adults with chronic kidney disease.
